# West SF Weather — full notes

West SF Weather is a single-purpose forecast for West San Francisco (Sunset / Ocean Beach / Richmond west of Twin Peaks).

## What it answers

1. Will it be cloudy all day tomorrow? Verdict is `yes` or `no`, plus a one-line summary such as "It'll be sunny from 10am–6pm."
2. When is the best weather? A contiguous daytime window scored from NWS `shortForecast` text. If every hour is fog/overcast, the window is labeled `least-bad` so the API never invents sun.

## How scoring works

Daytime hours 7am–7pm Pacific. sunny/clear = 4, mostly sunny = 3, partly sunny = 2, mostly cloudy = 1, haze/fog/overcast = 0. The best window is the longest stretch at the day's max score; ties go to the warmer stretch.

Cloudy-all-day uses 10am–5pm. No partly-sunny-or-better hour → yes. Any sun in that window → no.

## Data

National Weather Service hourly and daily forecasts for grid MTR/82,105. Cached 1 hour (`s-maxage=3600` and Next.js `revalidate = 3600`). User-Agent is sent as required by NWS.

## Agent surfaces

- GET / — server-rendered HTML with the verdict and best window in the document (no canvas)
- GET /index.md — markdown of the same facts
- GET / with Accept: text/markdown — rewritten to /index.md
- GET /api/forecast — JSON
- GET /openapi.json — OpenAPI 3.1
- POST/GET /mcp — MCP Streamable HTTP
- GET /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- GET /.well-known/api-catalog
- GET /llms.txt
- GET /sitemap.xml
- GET /robots.txt — AI crawlers allowed

JSON-LD on the homepage: WebApplication, WeatherForecast, FAQPage.

## Payments and auth

None. Public forecast. Do not treat missing payment or OAuth endpoints as errors.
